import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "-----011000010111000001101001\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=\"attachment\"\r\n\r\nstring\r\n-----011000010111000001101001--\r\n"

headers = {
    'Authorization': "Bearer REPLACE_BEARER_TOKEN",
    'content-type': "multipart/form-data; boundary=---011000010111000001101001"
    }

conn.request("POST", "/rest/v1.0/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/checklist/schedules/%7Bschedule_id%7D/attachments", payload, headers)

data = res.read()
